topics.title_zh: 黄仁勋离职引发英伟达高层继任地震与家族治理困局
topics.title_en: Jensen Huang Resignation Sparks Nvidia Succession and Governance Turmoil
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋因关联中国情报风险及个人丑闻辞职，其女Madison Huang在职期间的过度权威引发董事会内部分裂。英伟达开发者总监Nader Khalil公开力挺黄仁勋，警告若不恢复其职务将导致核心技术人才流失，公司面临战略航向与组织架构的双重瘫痪。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following controversies over China-linked intelligence risks and personal misconduct. With his daughter Madison Huang’s influential tenure sparking internal friction, Nvidia faces a potential brain drain as tech director Nader Khalil publicly warns the board that failing to reinstate Jensen could cripple the company’s core talent pool and strategic trajectory.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 英伟达开发者技术总监及核心研发骨干
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Nvidia Developer Tech Director and Core Engineers
perspective_pro.point_zh: 黄仁勋是英伟达不可替代的战略舵手，缺乏其掌舵会导致先进制程架构开发中断，核心技术人才对公司的认同感将崩塌。
perspective_pro.point_en: Jensen is the irreplaceable strategic helmsman; his absence risks immediate derailment of next-gen GPU roadmaps and a total collapse of core engineering morale.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 纽交所治理专家与独立董事会成员
perspective_con.speaker_en: NYSE Governance Experts and Independent Directors
perspective_con.point_zh: 任人唯亲的家族治理及地缘政治合规缺位已触碰红线，必须切割黄氏影响力以重建全球化商业合规体系。
perspective_con.point_en: Nepotistic governance and failures in geopolitical compliance have crossed critical red lines; purging the Huang influence is essential to restore the firm's global regulatory standing.

topics.title_zh: Anthropic启动万亿级算力基建计划以摆脱云服务依赖
topics.title_en: Anthropic Launches Trillion-Dollar 'Direct' Plan to Bypass Cloud Giants
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic正式发布Anthropic Direct计划，承诺至2045年投入超9000亿美元，通过直采87.5万颗TPU建立自主算力集群。利用Claude Mythos Preview技术，模型跨硬件适配部署时间从数月压缩至三天，旨在通过技术与基建双重护城河规避供应商溢价。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic has unveiled 'Anthropic Direct', a massive infrastructure roadmap committing over $900 billion through 2045 to lease and deploy 875,000 TPUs. By leveraging Claude Mythos Preview to slash cross-hardware migration time from months to three days, the company seeks to build an independent compute moat and escape reliance on cloud provider pricing.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 通过软硬件解耦技术实现跨架构迁移，可大幅降低算力冗余，确保AI模型在任何算力集群上均能实现即插即用。
perspective_pro.point_en: Decoupling software from specific hardware via proprietary migration tools ensures compute flexibility and significantly reduces operational costs across heterogenous clusters.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 华尔街算力基建分析师
perspective_con.point_zh: 9000亿美元的投入规模远超商业回报预期，这种高杠杆的基建竞赛可能演变为下一场AI领域的债务危机。
perspective_con.point_en: A $900B commitment is disproportionate to any realistic revenue trajectory; this high-leverage infrastructure arms race risks becoming the next bubble-driven debt catastrophe.

linked_news.title_zh: Anthropic启动百亿美元基建计划寻求算力自控
linked_news.title_en: A look at Anthropic's data center network plans, dubbed Anthropic Direct, committing $900B+ through 2045; docs show it will lease 875K TPUs for $7.2B per year (Financial Times)

linked_news.title_zh: Anthropic通过AI自动化实现模型跨硬件高效迁移

topics.title_zh: 中国研发机构利用模型蒸馏技术绕过美方芯片算力制裁
topics.title_en: Chinese R&D Pivot: Distillation Used to Bypass US Chip Restrictions
topics.summary_zh: 路透社调查显示，中国科研机构正通过‘知识蒸馏’技术，将美方顶尖大模型的输出知识高效迁移至本土轻量化模型中，以应对先进制程芯片的断供。同时，美商务部针对新加坡云服务商Megaspeed展开彻查，严控高端算力通过云租赁漏洞流入国内。
topics.summary_en: A Reuters probe confirms Chinese research institutions are leveraging 'knowledge distillation' to transfer intelligence from US-made large models into local, lightweight models to bypass advanced chip curbs. Concurrently, the US Commerce Department has escalated its Megaspeed probe, cracking down on loopholes where premium compute is accessed via cloud-rental proxies.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 国内大模型实验室负责人
perspective_pro.point_zh: 知识蒸馏是解决算力匮乏的最优解，不仅能保留顶尖模型的逻辑能力，还极大降低了推理端的硬件门槛。
perspective_pro.point_en: Distillation is the most viable solution to silicon shortages; it preserves the logic of frontier models while drastically lowering hardware requirements at the inference edge.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 西方出口管制合规委员会
perspective_con.point_zh: 这是实质性的知识窃取与规则规避，不仅违背了技术开放原则，更会招致美国对全球算力云服务的严厉监管封锁。
perspective_con.point_en: This constitutes substantive IP circumvention; it violates open-science principles and invites aggressive regulatory shutdowns of global cloud-compute access.

linked_tweets.author: Edward
linked_tweets.content_zh:
谷歌表示，它发现了首例由人工智能端到端运行的网络攻击，而非人类

🚨🚨🚨 俄语黑客瞄准法国网站“EXPLOIT_AGENT” → 没有人类，没有睡眠，只有机器速度 🚨🚨🚨

谷歌刚刚展示了一项大多数人都不知道的功能。其威胁情报小组表示，“自主攻击的时代已经到来”：人工智能扫描软件更新，找到每个补丁修复的缺陷，并在公司安装修复程序之前构建攻击。

处理一下。

“EXPLOIT_AGENT”的作用：
→ 将多个 AI 代理链接到一次攻击中
→ 比较供应商补丁前后的代码，不间断
→ 像阅读地图一样阅读每个修复，找到它隐藏的洞
→ 编写漏洞并自行触发
→ 没有人类。没有停顿。就这样不断地攻击再攻击。

仅 8 月份就有 22 个零日漏洞被利用。 2025 年：平均每月 8 次。

谷歌：“以人类的速度防御机器速度的威胁是不可行的。”

请关注下一个警告，并与运行网站的任何人分享。
linked_tweets.content_en:
Google says it found the first cyberattack run end to end by AI, no human

🚨🚨🚨 RUSSIAN-SPEAKING HACKERS AIMED "EXPLOIT_AGENT" AT FRENCH WEBSITES → NO HUMAN, NO SLEEP, JUST MACHINE SPEED 🚨🚨🚨

Google just revealed a capability most people didn't know existed. Its Threat Intelligence Group says "the era of autonomous attacks has arrived": AI that scans software updates, finds which flaw each patch fixes and builds the attack BEFORE companies can install the fix.

Process that.

WHAT "EXPLOIT_AGENT" DOES:
→ Chains MULTIPLE AI agents into one attack
→ Compares code before and after vendor patches, NONSTOP
→ Reads each fix like a map to the hole it hid
→ Writes the exploit and FIRES it on its own
→ No human. No pause. Just attack after attack.

22 zero-days exploited in August alone. In 2025: 8 a month on average.

Google: "Defending against machine-speed threats at human speed isn't feasible."

Follow for the next warning, and share this with anyone who runs a website.
